**Are you an experienced accountant with payroll experience? Take on a key role in a modern finance team and help shape smarter processes.

**

On behalf of our client, MARPRO Group is looking for a Senior Accountant and Payroll Specialist for their office in Lyngby. You will report to the Head of Accounting of the company.

The job

As a Senior Accountant and Payroll Specialist you will play a key role in supporting the accounting operations and partnering closely with the Head of Accounting. Combining payroll oversight and accounting expertise, you will help ensure accurate reporting, strong accounting controls and high-quality payroll processes. This is a broad and impactful role where you will have the opportunity to drive improvements, contribute to process optimization and make a real difference in a modern, international accounting team.

Professional qualifications

• 
Relevant professional experience within Accounting, Finance, Payroll, or a comparable function.

• 
Solid experience with month-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations and financial reporting.

• 
Hands-on experience supporting payroll processes, payroll controls and payroll-related reconciliations.

• 
Strong analytical skills and proficiency in ERP systems and Excel

• 
Fluent Danish and English communication skills, both written and spoken

**

Personal characteristics**

• 
You are a self-driven professional who takes ownership, acts proactively and delivers with confidence and integrity.

• 
You combine strong analytical skills and attention to detail with the ability to understand the broader business context.

• 
You thrive in a dynamic environment, remaining calm, structured and solution-oriented when priorities shift.

• 
You build trust through clear communication and enjoy collaborating with stakeholders across all levels of the organization.

• 
You are naturally curious and motivated by challenging existing ways of working, driving continuous improvement, efficiency and innovation.

Our client offers

• 
A newly created role where you will help shape the function, take ownership of your responsibilities, and maintain a hands-on approach to supporting the wider team when required.

• 
Acting as a trusted partner to the Head of Accounting, supporting key accounting and payroll activities while ensuring high quality and continuity across the function

• 
Supported by competitive compensation and a specialized industry environment.

• 
A collaborative and knowledgeable team with deep expertise, where knowledge sharing, respect and cross-functional support are part of everyday work.

• 
A flexible working environment with an informal culture and a healthy work-life balance, including a 37-hour work week.

• 
Modern office facilities in Lyngby, complemented by lunch, fresh fruit and a variety of employee benefits and social activities.

Application

The application process is handled by MARPRO Group. If you have any questions about this position, please contact MARPRO Group at +45 5370 0995.

If you are interested in the position, please upload a motivated application and an updated CV via the application button. You will receive a confirmation email from us. Please check your spam folder, if you have not received the confirmation within 10 minutes after applying, to ensure future communication.

Do you want to be part of an international company where precision, compliance, and employee service go hand in hand? For our People, Branding & Sustainability team, we are looking for a Lead - Payroll & Compliance for our location at KK Group in Hammel.

In this role, you will be an important, trusted partner for employees, managers, and external stakeholders, ensuring accurate payroll administration, high-quality payroll processes, and compliance with labor legislation and internal policies. You will play a key role in managing working time, absences, reporting, and coordination with external payroll vendors, while also contributing to the development and optimization of processes and systems.

If you thrive in a role with responsibility, structure, and close collaboration across the organization, this could be the next step in your career.

Responsibilities

• Ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of input data for payroll processing, including absence, working hours, and other payroll-related information

• Working closely with external payroll providers and supporting effective coordination of payroll activities

• Handling People-related tasks within your area of responsibility

• Providing professional support and guidance to employees and managers on payroll and compliance matters

• Handling absence-related tasks and communicating relevant information to employees and managers

• Administering payroll and employee benefit matters related to employee absence

• Supporting tax and insurance settlements in collaboration with external providers

• Preparing reports, payroll data, and analyses

• Advising business leaders on employment law and payroll-related matters within your area of expertise

• Providing guidance in connection with the preparation of contracts, addendums etc.

• Supporting internal and external audits

• Contributing to the implementation of new payroll systems e.g. HR systems and software.

• Supporting the implementation of new employee benefits in payroll processes

• Participating in projects related to payroll, compliance, and the continued development of the function

• Identifying opportunities to improve payroll processes, data quality, and employee service

Don’t meet all the requirements? No worries – if you are passionate about payroll and compliance, enjoy a collaborative environment, and embrace a culture of continuous learning and development, we would still love to hear from you.

Your Profile

• You have several years of experience in a similar role within payroll, compliance, or HR administration

• You can communicate fluently in Danish and English

• You have experience working with payroll in a manufacturing environment and understand the specific requirements associated with this type of organization

• You have solid knowledge of Danish employment law and social security regulations

• You have hands-on experience with time registration, absence management, and payroll processes

• You work in a structured and detail-oriented manner, with a strong focus on accuracy and quality

• You are service-minded and motivated by supporting employees and managers

• You have strong communication and collaboration skills and are comfortable working with stakeholders across the organization

• You are confident working with payroll data, reporting, and analyses

• You have strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly in Excel

• You have a relevant educational background in employment law, economics, finance, payroll, or a related field

• Experience with D365, including the Time & Attendance and HR modules, will be considered an advantage

• You have valid driver’s license

Location

The position is based at KK Group’s location in Hammel.

How to Apply

If you are ambitious, detail-oriented, and motivated by making an impact in a growing international organization, please send your CV and apply today. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis.

For further information regarding the position, please contact: Camilla Sjølund Sørensen at casor@kkgroup.com

About KK Group

With more than 40 years of experience, KK Group is a leading systems supplier to the renewable energy industry. Our capabilities range from developing state-of-the-art technologies and high-quality lean manufacturing to flexible aftermarket services. KK Group is owned by A.P. Moller Holding, the parent company of the A.P. Moller Group, established in 1904 by Arnold Peter Møller.

We are a global and diverse team of more than 3,700 employees working together to deliver products and services that enable a future powered by renewable energy.

At KK Group, our culture and DNA are built on a strong can-do attitude and a focus on innovation. We actively foster an inclusive work environment that embraces diversity, rejects any form of discrimination, and provides equal opportunities for all. Our commitment is to build a culture centered around health, safety, wellbeing, and strong collaboration.

Do you want to play a key role in developing Ambu’s CMO network and ensuring reliable supply in a fast-growing, regulated MedTech business? Do you thrive in a role where you need to balance business priorities, operational performance, quality, cost, and the needs of many stakeholders?

Then this might be your defining moment. Join Ambu’s Global Supply Chain team and help build a scalable CMO setup that supports our ambitious growth strategy.

**Drive performance and develop our CMO network

**As CMO Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of Ambu’s external manufacturing network. You will work closely with our CMO partners to secure capacity, maintain reliable production schedules, improve performance, and ensure that products are available when needed. Part of the assignment includes being part of the NPI process. The role will also from time to time include project participation as well as project ownership in various tactical and operational initiatives

The role combines operational execution with continuous improvement and process development of the CMO setup. You will collaborate with R&D, QA, Procurement, Sales, and Global Planning and external stakeholders

You will report to the Global Head of Global Operational Planning and Aftersales and be part of the Global Supply Chain organization. The position is based in Ballerup, Denmark.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Manage a portfolio of CMO partners, ensuring effective capacity utilization, reliable production schedules, and product availability by balancing demand, lead times, capacity, and material availability.

• Develop and expand the CMO supplier network in line with Ambu’s business and supply chain strategy.

• Monitor CMO performance and production data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities, and to own and resolve escalations related to capacity, supply, quality, and delivery performance.

• Manage inventory levels for CMO-produced products, balancing customer service, supply risk, and working capital.

• Partner with R&D, QA, Procurement, Sales, and Global Planning to ensure effective end-to-end collaboration and compliance with relevant regulatory and documentation requirements.

• Lead and drive improvement initiatives across the CMO network, focusing on performance, efficiency, scalability, and cost.

• Take ownership of the CMO process and support the development of Ambu’s processes.

• Participate and represent Global supply chain in NPI related activities.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be gained in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

• Around 5 years of experience in operations, supply chain, or OEM/CMO management, preferably within MedTech or another regulated, compliance- and quality-focused industry.

• A solid understanding of QA/RA requirements and the operational demands of regulated manufacturing.

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a similar relevant field.

• Experience driving projects and improvement initiatives across functions and organizations.

• Strong business understanding combined with a pragmatic and structured approach to assessing situations, prioritizing actions, and making timely decisions.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to navigate effectively across multiple internal and external touchpoints.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Combine weather modelling, machine learning and Python to turn complex data into actionable insights and production-ready solutions that support trading decisions across various power markets.

The job

Here’s what the job entails

In the role, you will work at the intersection of weather data modelling and fundamental forecasting, driving research and innovation within quantitative weather analysis.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

• 
conducting research in AI- and data-driven weather modelling within a power trading context

• 
developing and improving fundamental forecasting solutions that translate weather signals into actionable power market insights

• 
performing ad hoc weather and market analyses to support trading, renewable asset balancing and commercial decision-making

• 
exploring new data sources, modelling approaches and analytical methods to strengthen our quantitative weather capabilities

• 
turning research and analysis into robust, scalable solutions that can be used directly by traders and algorithms

The team

Meet the team

You will join our Quantitative Weather Analysis team, where we develop weather-driven insights, forecasts and models that support trading decisions and renewable asset optimisation across our business.

We are a team of specialists with backgrounds in data science, physics and computational biophysics. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves, and aim to create an informal atmosphere and a team where people genuinely enjoy working together. We also value spending time with each other beyond the task at hand, whether that is grabbing a coffee, having lunch or simply catching up during the day. Together, we have built a culture where we help each other, share knowledge freely and feel comfortable asking questions or challenging ideas.

By combining multidimensional weather data, machine learning and market understanding, you’ll help shape trading decisions and optimise the balancing of our renewable asset portfolio.

Talia Zeppelin

Head of Quantitative Weather Analysis

Your qualifications

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be working deeply with quantitative modelling and large datasets, we imagine that you take a curious and proactive approach to your tasks. You enjoy digging into how things work with a research-to-action mindset and challenge existing approaches when you see room for improvement. We also expect that you are comfortable taking ownership of projects while collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• 
have an educational background in Economics, Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science or a related quantitative field

• 
are experienced in writing production-quality, maintainable code in Python

• 
are comfortable working in Linux-based environments and using common command-line tools

• 
have a solid quantitative foundation and can work with statistical, mathematical or data-driven modelling

• 
can work with large, complex datasets and transform data-driven insights into practical solutions

• 
are curious about the power trading domain and has an execution and collaborative mindset

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters

Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

About You

You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

• Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.

• Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.

• Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.

• Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.

• Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.

• Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.

• Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives
